rowdata.pyStepsDescription: If WorkObjectClass not defined, use primary page class
If param defined change the name of the flow list page
Call case type for AdHoc flows
Add flow list page if it doesn't exist
Call casetype for Optional Stage Flows
Copy optional flows to pyPageName page
get list of flows through lookup list
run the list to get checked out rules
Append the checked out records to the original list
